notes_for_editor: Thin. The only pages are the Eastern US Lookouts listing (name and Clay County heading) and a Mapcarta gazetteer entry built from OpenStreetMap and GeoNames. The 105 ft figure is the point's elevation, not a tower height. No build, staffing, fate or access sources. A search surfaced a news item about a wildfire near Sun Garden Road in Clay County; it says nothing about the tower and is not used. Spelling differs: Sun Garden (listing and brief) against Sungarden (Mapcarta, OSM). Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Florida lists in the cache. The story is short because the sources support no more; the editor may choose to keep it short or hold it for more research. Status and access unknown.
